digest.component_or_area: fsck scan, compact-all, archive operations, ticket maintenance walk
propositions: Store-wide maintenance walks (fsck scan loops and compact-all sweeps) visit every ticket directory including archived ones, making routine health checks O(all tickets) and slower as store grows
Archive operation writes ARCHIVED event and .archived marker but does not fold the ticket, leaving unfolded events that are folded only by later compact-all walks reaching archived tickets

fsck and compact-all should default to visiting only active (non-archived) tickets, skipping .archived marker dirs after confirming net-archived state, with --include-archived flag to restore full walk
rebar archive must perform terminal fold inline before writing ARCHIVED event, ensuring all archived ticket events are covered by a SNAPSHOT even if default compact-all never reaches it
A ticket archived by pre-change builds (unfolded, no inline fold) can be folded by compact-all --include-archived as a belt-and-suspenders path for legacy compatibility
